note: MODEL ABLATION 2026-11-13: every model of the runtime switched on/off end to end (scripts/eval-ablation.mjs, scripts/ablation-report.mjs). Outcomes: right / wrong (partly counts as wrong) / asked / nu (not understood); sets without gold: answered / asked / nu. Reasoner: matrix. Dispatcher: docs/webchat/models/dispatcher (int8, 68.0 MB), normalizer docs/webchat/models/normalizer (int8, 97.0 MB). The full runs share 20 cores; time per message comes from the single-thread latency sample (400 rows).

configs.enc-suspect: as enc-C plus the suspect-word leniency prototype
configs.rules-RDfill: no model; READER-ROUTE = fill (the library reader reads clauses nobody read)
configs.rules-WAchoose-RDchoose: no model; world-aware = choose and READER-ROUTE = choose
configs.rules-also-suspect: no model; both prototypes (also-joiner, suspect-word leniency)
configs.rules-also: no model; PROTOTYPE "also" joins clauses like "then" in the rules clause splitter
configs.rules-suspect: no model; PROTOTYPE suspect-word leniency (a completely read segment with an unknown word one slip from a known word is spell-corrected like an unparsed one)
configs.enc-A: as enc-C with routing A (the encoder world head proposes, the rules validate)
configs.enc-B: as enc-C with routing B (symbolic only, the encoder world head unread)
configs.enc-C-segrules: as enc-C, the rules clause splitter replaces the model segmentation
configs.enc-C: encoder: segmentation + world prior + validator; reading by rules only; routing C; no normalizer
configs.enc-hybrid: enc-C plus the NX reading of segments the rules left unparsed (hybrid); no normalizer
configs.enc-n1: enc-C plus the T5 normalizer fallback; reading by rules only
configs.rules-A: no model; rules formalizer; the old rule router (routing A)
configs.rules-C: no model; rules formalizer; meta.worlds routing (B, no encoder prior)
configs.shipped: the shipped default: encoder + normalizer + hybrid reading + routing C
configs.enc-neural-n1: model first (NX neural) with the normalizer
